functions.name: VDP_PrepareTileRowCommandsStride16
functions.body: Writes 0x9010 to VDP_CONTROL, loads D1 with 0x40, calls VDP_BuildTileRowCommandTables at 0x001B2142, and returns.
functions.effect: Configures the VDP increment and prepares the fixed 0x40-word tile-row command set.

functions.name: SceneResource_RunServiceFramesWhileReady
functions.body: Tests SCENE_RESOURCE_STATUS at 0x00FF7E22. When clear, preserves D0 around each iteration, calls Terrain_QueryFlagDispatcher at 0x001B319C, calls Frame_RunServicePass at 0x001B28AE, waits through Frame_WaitForVBlankWork at 0x001B249E, restores D0, and repeats with DBF.
functions.effect: Runs a caller-counted scene/resource service loop that is suppressed while the resource status latch is set.

functions.name: SceneResource_RunSingleServiceFrame
functions.body: Tests SCENE_RESOURCE_STATUS, waits through Frame_WaitForVBlankWork, preserves the full D0-D7/A0-A7 register set around Terrain_QueryFlagDispatcher and Frame_RunServicePass, and returns.
functions.effect: Provides one gated scene/resource service frame with full register preservation.

functions.name: Render_FadePaletteBandToWhite
functions.body: Sets the VDP palette address to 0xC000, snapshots 16 words into CURRENT_VDP_PALETTE, then repeats 16 outer passes. Each pass waits for VBlank and advances every palette word's 0x000E, 0x00E0, and 0x0E00 component groups by +2 until each group reaches its maximum mask value, writing each result through VDP_DATA.
functions.effect: Fades one 16-word palette band toward white in 16 VBlank-paced passes.

functions.name: Render_FadePaletteToWhite
functions.body: Sets the VDP palette address to 0xC000, snapshots 64 words into CURRENT_VDP_PALETTE, then repeats 16 outer passes. Each pass waits for VBlank and advances every palette word's 0x000E, 0x00E0, and 0x0E00 component groups by +2 until each group reaches its maximum mask value, writing each result through VDP_DATA.
functions.effect: Fades the complete 64-word palette toward white in 16 VBlank-paced passes.

limitations: No direct static caller was exported for the five entries, so the record establishes their local contracts without assigning a particular scene-state or UI presentation.
The two palette fades are named by their exact monotonic component behavior; runtime evidence is still needed to identify which scene transitions invoke them.
conclusion: The adjacent scene/render gap contains two gated service wrappers, one VDP stride setup wrapper, and two complete monotonic palette-to-white fades. Their non-overlapping boundaries and exact VBlank/word/component counts are now recorded.
